288285502_9e1ca00b.text: Previous work has established that the hormone ghrelin engages the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal neuroendocrine axis via activation of corticotropin-releasing factor (CRF) neurons of the hypothalamic paraventricular nucleus (PVN)

288285502_fbb0eef2.text: .Here, we show that ghrelin-induced activation of PVN CRF neurons involved inhibition of γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) inputs, likely via ghrelin binding sites that were localized at GABAergic terminals within the PVN

288285502_45a1a749.text: .These data support the notion that ghrelin activates PVN CRF neurons via inhibition of local GABAergic tone, in an ARC- independent manner.
